correctness.rationale: The full-path left/right pieces include Y0 and Y1; subtracting the affine interpolation at t yields two independent Brownian bridge residuals independent of (Y0,Y1,Xt). Thus CMI of full paths conditional Xt is exactly I(Y0;Y1|Xt), without an infinite mesh limit. The Gaussian posterior precision is J=C^-1+[(1-t),t]^T[(1-t),t]/[t(1-t)], whose off-diagonal equals 1-c/Δ. The resulting partial correlation yields the claimed log(1-rho²) formula. Setting r=(1-t)/t, AM–GM minimizes ar+b/r uniquely at sqrt(b/a), except flat Δ=c. For PSD singular C, c≠0 gives a rank-one non-atomic conditional joint supported on a line singular to the product marginals, hence KL=+infty, while c=0 makes one endpoint deterministic, CMI 0. KL disintegration proves unique closest factorized cut law when finite; no all-time Markov projection is claimed.
